input.quote: 5.3 Any of the Parties may at its own expense insure against risks so far as its own share of such costs is concerned. Should the Parties jointly agree to insure against risks, the costs of such insurance shall form part of the Capital Costs, as approved by the Management Committee.
input.rationale: The only insurance language in the Agreement is permissive and cost-related: Paragraph 5.3 (p0139) lets each Party voluntarily insure its own cost share, and p0133 treats insurance (or an allowance in lieu where a Party self-insures) as a cost element. Neither imposes any coverage obligation or minimum limit, so the fallback (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000) is not met on any material term. Under Paragraph 10 the Terminal Parties and Maintenance Authorities operate and maintain the Wet Segment, Segment T and the terminal stations we access and through which our Allocated Capacity is carried - the vendor-analogue role here - so we bound them alone rather than adding a mutual covenant that would also burden Teleglobe. We targeted the fallback level and omitted the preferred extras (CGL limits, workers' compensation, certificates) and the model clause's at-own-expense and one-year survival tails, which no selected element requires.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.

proposal.summary: Insert a short fallback-level insurance covenant (E&O USD 1M; cyber/privacy USD 2M) on the Terminal Parties and Maintenance Authorities
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a short insurance covenant at our fallback position - errors and omissions cover of at least USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy cover of at least USD 2,000,000 - binding the Terminal Parties and Maintenance Authorities that operate and maintain the facilities carrying our capacity, since Paragraph 5.3 only permits voluntary self-insurance and sets no minimum limits.

ops.text: INSURANCE Each Terminal Party and each Maintenance Authority shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.
